description: This Java class 'CodeFormater' helps format code or tabular data into a structured, column-aligned output. It manages rows and columns, computes maximum widths for columns, and outputs formatted buffers or streams, primarily used for presenting code or data in a tabular, readable format.

classes.name: CodeFormater
classes.description: A helper class for aligning generated code or data into a tabular format, managing rows and columns, and producing formatted string or stream output.

methods.name: CodeFormater
methods.description: Constructor initializing the formatter with a specified number of columns.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in a specified column of the current row, updating the maximum column width.

methods.name: nextRow
methods.description: Advances to the next row, adding a new blank row for further data.

methods.name: appendFillerRow
methods.description: Adds a filler row with a specified line, used for separation or headers.

methods.name: printBuffer
methods.description: Outputs the formatted rows to a PrintWriter stream with specified padding.

methods.name: toStringBuffer
methods.description: Returns a string buffer with the formatted content, suitable for display or logging.
